detail.longDescription: Northflank tells all users to assume their environment variables are decrypted and rotate keys now. Its Oct 30 notice reports users' AI keys being used, yet gives no entry point or affected-user count. It says Postgres/MongoDB secret rotation is enabled for everyone and recommends disabling public addon exposure. https:// status.northflank.com/ # Northflank # CloudSecurity # DevOps # Cybersecurity
